results.summary: Read-only analysis of pyaas-consumer 5f92d2e (origin/feature/ui-revamp, Kushagra, 22 Sep, parent 81a33ec = origin/feature/consumer-revamp-phase2) against backend parag-saathi-be integration/delivery (5146fb1) and our local feature/consumer-revamp-phase2 (f7e19be, 44 commits past merge-base 5730291). LENS A result: the commit adds six brand-new API calls and none of them exist in internal/modules/consumer/module.go: GET /consumer/founding-family, POST /consumer/founding-family/join, POST /consumer/founding-family/stop, GET /consumer/referrals/code, GET /consumer/referrals, POST /consumer/referrals/apply. The Founding Family program is NOT client-side: every farm, seat count, price, member status and line number is read from GET /founding-family and the app shows "opening soon" when it is absent, so the feature is dead until the backend ships the three endpoints plus server-side member pricing (the app deleted its own 10% discount, so ERP level-3 pricing must now come from catalog_price.go, which today has no member dimension). It does not read a flag on GET /me (account.membership_tier exists on the model but is never used by this commit) and expects no CRM trigger from the app side, though spec 6/8/9 (unlock/you're-in notifications, Plus migration, FOUNDING-99 ERP item) are all server work. P-DAN needs no new endpoint: it posts kind:"agent" to the existing POST /consumer/partner-leads, whose handler stores kind as a free string. Legal sync needs no endpoint: constants/legal.ts is generated at build time by scripts/sync-legal.py from www.pyaasdairy.com and rendered statically. Two backend behaviours the commit silently depends on are also missing: createSubscription (subscriptions.go:502) inserts unconditionally, so the DUPLICATE_SUBSCRIPTION guard is client-only (and reads a local table that our phase2 turned into an outbox, so it is a no-op in backend mode), and locked morning orders whose day passed are never closed (sweep step EXPIRE only cancels unlocked previews), so the new isActive() date filter hides rows the server still treats as live. Persistence: the only domain writes the commit adds are in lib/referrals.ts (a cached server code, acceptable, and a local referred_by written whether or not POST /referrals/apply succeeded, which is a violation and reverses our phase2 policy). Overlap: 18 files changed on both sides with real semantic conflicts in lib/subscriptions.ts (his index.tsx and SubscriptionStatusCard.tsx still call syncServerSubscriptions, which our branch deleted: a merge does not compile), lib/notifications.ts (three-way: our installTapHandler/unregisterPush/singleflight registerForPush vs 81a33ec's registeredFor vs his onNotificationTap/scheduleAt), lib/referrals.ts (opposite backend-mode policies) and components/RateAppSheet.tsx (deleted vs modified). Recommendation: do not merge 5f92d2e into phase2 now; have Kushagra merge phase2 into his branch first and resolve the four files above on our semantics, while we cherry-pick the backend-independent, non-overlapping pieces (legal sync, Celebrity Gardens, grievance strings, FAQ row, inbox redirect, P-DAN/bulk-order screens, active-orders filter, ActiveOrdersCard, wallet back button) and hold Founding Family and referrals until the six endpoints exist.
backend_needs: lib/foundingFamily.ts:88 getFoundingFamily -> api.get('/founding-family') = GET /consumer/founding-family (authenticated). Expects { price_month:number (required, else treated as absent), member: null | { status:'waiting'|'active'|'stopped', farm_id, line_number?, referral_code?, joined_at?, next_bill_date? }, farms: [{ id, name, farmer, place?, note?, photo_url?, unlocks_at:number, claimed:number, status:'filling'|'unlocked', unlocked_packs? }] (required array), savings?: { level1_per_litre, level3_per_litre, delivery_fee } }. module.go: NO (no route; git grep 'founding' over internal/**/*.go finds only a comment). Backend must add the handler under the pr (svc.authenticate) group, sourcing farms/seat counts/price from the ERP per pyaas-app-spec.md; any non-2xx or malformed body makes the app say 'Founding Family opens in the app soon', so nothing crashes today but the whole tab, profile card and PromoGate upsell are inert.

lib/foundingFamily.ts:120 joinFoundingFamily -> api.post('/founding-family/join', { farm_id }) = POST /consumer/founding-family/join. Expects { member: Member } and error bodies in the existing apiError shape { code, message } (plumbing.go:45) with code WALLET_SHORT (the app regexes the shortfall out of message: /short(?:fall)?\D*(\d+)/i, so put the rupee figure in the message or add a shortfall field), FARM_UNLOCKED, ALREADY_MEMBER; a 404 is mapped to NOT_AVAILABLE. module.go: NO. Backend must: debit price_month (99) from the wallet server-side, book it as a customer advance against FOUNDING-99, set status 'waiting', assign line_number, refuse when the farm is already unlocked or the member already holds a seat. Note app/founding-family/join.tsx:46 pre-checks the wallet balance client-side against price_month and routes to /recharge first, so WALLET_SHORT is only the race fallback.

lib/foundingFamily.ts:132 stopFoundingFamily -> api.post('/founding-family/stop') (no body) = POST /consumer/founding-family/stop. Expects { member } with status 'stopped'; perks are meant to run to the end of the paid month (server decides). module.go: NO.

Founding Family program shape: NOT purely client-side. No local table, no AsyncStorage, no flag typed into the app (only PromoGate.tsx:164 still prints the client constant PLUS_PRICE_MONTH=99 from lib/vip.ts, a small spec breach). It does NOT read GET /me for membership (account.MembershipTier in models.go:43 exists but is unused by this commit), so a membership endpoint is required, not a /me flag. Server-side work the app now assumes: (a) member pricing: lib/vip.ts memberLinePrice now returns the regular price always, so ERP level-3 price on PYAAS milk and free delivery for active members must be applied in catalog_price.go/createOrder/subscription orders (priceFor(product, variant) has no member dimension today); (b) spec 6 notification texts (farm unlocked, you're in, seat waiting) as CRM triggers, none exist in crm_triggers.json; (c) spec 8 migration of existing Plus members; (d) spec 9 ERP items (FOUNDING-99). The share link in foundingFamily.ts:147 points at www.pyaasdairy.com/foundationfamily?ref=CODE, a website route to confirm, not this backend.

lib/referrals.ts:66 getReferralCode -> api.get('/referrals/code') = GET /consumer/referrals/code. Expects { code:string }. module.go: NO. The consumer account model already carries referral_code (models.go:41, json 'referral_code') and updateMe (service.go:395) blocks it as server-controlled, but nothing ever writes it. Backend must mint and return the member's code; to keep already-shared codes attributing, use the app's derivation ('PG' + base36(h).toUpperCase() + 'XXXX').slice(0,6) with h = h*31 + charCode over the consumer id, unsigned 32-bit (lib/referrals.codeFromUid). Until it exists the app falls back to the on-device derivation.

lib/referrals.ts:94 listReferrals -> api.get('/referrals') = GET /consumer/referrals. Expects a JSON array of { id, name, status, reward_amount, created_at } (must be Array.isArray, sorted client-side by created_at desc). module.go: NO. Backend must keep the referrer-side ledger (who joined with my code, what was credited). Only rider referrals exist today (rider_ops_profile.go, GET /consumer/delivery/rider/referral), a different program.

lib/referrals.ts:131 setReferredBy -> api.post('/referrals/apply', { code }) = POST /consumer/referrals/apply, called from app/complete-profile.tsx at sign-up; errors are swallowed. module.go: NO. Backend must validate the code, link referee to referrer once, and apply the reward. Open product decision the handoff flags: the Refer screen promises 'Gift Rs100, get Rs100' (REFERRAL_REWARD) while pyaas-app-spec 5.8 / One Voice say a referral only moves you up the Founding Family line; the endpoint cannot be built until the founder decides.

app/business.tsx (Earn with PYAAS / P-DAN) -> lib/leads.ts:63 submitLead -> api.post('/partner-leads', row) with kind:'agent', name, phone, businessName:'', city (labelled Locality), message; app/bulk-order.tsx:62 posts kind:'bulk_order' with the product chips, cadence and quantity folded into message. module.go: YES (cr.Post('/partner-leads', h.createPartnerLead), leads.go:29, app-key gated). Handler stores kind as a free string (no enum), so 'agent' is accepted with no change; the extra row fields id/created_at are ignored by decode. Only follow-up: whoever reads consumer_partner_leads should label kind 'agent' as P-DAN. No content endpoint expected for P-DAN.

Legal sync (constants/legal.ts, scripts/sync-legal.py, app/terms.tsx, app/privacy-policy.tsx): the script fetches www.pyaasdairy.com/terms and /privacy at build time and bakes them into constants/legal.ts; the screens render the constant. No backend content endpoint is called or expected. lib/support.ts:68-69 GRIEVANCE_OFFICER/GRIEVANCE_EMAIL are constants synced by hand to the website. Backend nothing to add; the handoff's section 10 notes (CIN typo on the website, cut-off and support-hours mismatches) are website fixes.

lib/subscriptions.ts:225 createSubscription DUPLICATE_SUBSCRIPTION guard: no new API call, but it depends on the server refusing a second active/paused subscription for the same consumer+product. module.go/subscriptions.go: NO guard (createSubscription at subscriptions.go:502 inserts unconditionally after price/address checks). Backend must reject with apiError code DUPLICATE_SUBSCRIPTION (409/422) when an active or paused row exists for (consumer_id, product_id[, variant]); the client guard reads the local 'subscriptions' table, which on phase2 is only the offline outbox in backend mode, so server enforcement is the only real one. Also requested in HANDOFF section 1: audit the founder's account for duplicate active subscriptions and cancel the extras before settleDeliveredOrders debits per row.

lib/orderTracking.ts:38-54 deliveryDayOf/isActive (used by app/(tabs)/orders.tsx and useLiveOrders/ActiveOrdersCard): reads o.status, o.placed_at, o.delivery_date, o.lane, o.delivery_window from GET /consumer/orders. module.go: YES; orders.go:98-121 serves all five (delivery_date and lane omitempty). Gap the filter papers over: a locked morning order whose day passed undelivered stays 'placed' forever (sweep step 1 EXPIRE at subscriptions.go:805 only cancels unlocked previews), so the app hides it while the server, ops screens and the wallet settle path still treat it as live. Backend must decide and implement closure (cancel/expire) of past-day undelivered locked orders.

Cut-off copy: app/subscriptions.tsx, app/product/[id].tsx and components/StartDatePicker.tsx now say 12 noon the day before for everything. Backend worker still schedules tomorrow's preview from 13:00 IST and locks at 00:00 (subscriptions.go:660-665, 917, scheduleFromHourIST). No endpoint, but the worker's lock/edit law must move to 12:00 noon the day before (and apply to new morning orders) or the copy is false.

Push shape for closed-app order updates: lib/orderTracking.ts:197 and lib/notificationCenter.ts:229 post local notifications with identifier 'order:<id>' so each status update replaces the last, title 'Arriving in N mins' / 'Arriving by 7:30 AM', body the status line, data.href '/order/<id>'. Backend push.go stores tokens only and has no FCM/APNs sender, so nothing to change now; when a sender lands, its payload should carry the same title/body/identifier/data.href so server and local notices coalesce (our phase2 dropNoticesTheServerSent pairs CRM rows D-01/D-02/D-06 with local notices, all present in crm_triggers.json).

Taglines (lib/taglines.ts) and cart reminder (lib/cartReminder.ts): purely local OS-scheduled notifications via expo-notifications scheduleAt/cancelScheduledWhere; no backend call. They read listOrders() and listSubscriptions() to pick the group and gate on the local 'consents' table (taglines.ts offersOn -> getRows('consents')) falling back to defaultChoices().marketing (now true). Not a backend need, but in backend mode our phase2 treats GET /users/me/consents as the truth, so offersOn should read the server's latest (useConsents.latest / readServerConsents) rather than the local audit rows, or a revoke made elsewhere never stops the 2-hourly lines.

Messages folded into Notifications: app/inbox.tsx is now a Redirect to /notifications and lib/notificationCenter.ts:89 sets each CRM row's href to crmCtaRoute(m.cta)?.href. Still uses existing GET /consumer/crm/inbox and POST /consumer/crm/inbox/{id}/read (module.go: YES). No change needed.

Consent defaults (components/ConsentSheet.tsx defaultChoices marketing/whatsapp/sms = true, complete-profile pre-ticked) and 'email' row removed: still mirrored through the existing consents outbox to POST /users/me/consents (module.go: YES, consents.go accepts the 7 kinds; marketing_email stays false). No endpoint change, but consents.go's derived 'promotional' aggregate now flips true for every new member by default; the handoff itself flags DPDP/TRAI/Apple 4.5.4 exposure, so the backend/CRM should not treat a default-true row as affirmative consent until the founder rules.

Rating prompt: lib/appReview.ts requestNativeReview uses expo-store-review (SKStoreReviewController / Play in-app review); openStoreReview opens the store page. No backend. components/RateAppSheet.tsx deleted, so the 1-3 star complaint filing path (POST /consumer/complaints) is gone from the rating flow.

Backend copy surfaced in the app that the founder wants em-dash free (handoff section 9), verified present: internal/modules/consumer/service.go:176, 212, 219 (OTP send/verify errors) and internal/modules/identity/service.go:169, 192, 307, 315. Cosmetic string edits, no contract change.

Celebrity Gardens (constants/societies.ts): address rows will carry society_id 'celebrity-gardens' through the existing POST/PATCH /consumer/addresses (module.go: YES); structured fields unchanged from the 18 Sep handoff. No backend change; supplying coordinates lets the app auto-pick it from a pin.
persistence_violations: lib/referrals.ts:69 putSingle('referral_code', uid, { code }) after a successful GET /referrals/code: a cache of a server-issued value used only as an offline fallback. Not a violation. The remaining fallback on the same function (codeFromUid derivation, and the stored code when the endpoint 404s) does mint a domain value on the device that the server may never honour; our phase2 already treats this as not-a-promise in backend mode.

lib/referrals.ts:126 putSingle('referral_meta', uid, { referred_by }) written BEFORE and regardless of POST /referrals/apply, whose failure (today a 404) is swallowed: VIOLATION of backend-as-source-of-truth. The device asserts 'referred by CODE' with no server acknowledgement and no retry queue, so the Refer screen and any later backfill will disagree with the ledger. Should be an outbox op (mirrorQueue) or written only after the POST succeeds; our phase2 setReferredBy returns false and writes nothing in backend mode.

lib/referrals.ts:103 listReferrals fallback to the local 'referrals' table when GET /referrals is absent: read-only, but it presents an empty device ledger as the member's referral history. Not a write violation; classify as stale-fallback display.

lib/subscriptions.ts:225 getRows('subscriptions') for the DUPLICATE_SUBSCRIPTION check: read-only, but on phase2 that table is the offline OUTBOX in backend mode (server plans live in the session cache), so the guard reads nothing and silently passes. Not a write violation; a source-of-truth misread that must be re-pointed at listSubscriptions().

lib/autoTopup.ts:45 DEFAULTS.on = true (AsyncStorage pref): UI preference, allowed. Note the interaction with phase2's clearAutoTopup(), which resets to DEFAULTS on sign-out/deletion, so the next account on the handset starts armed.

components/ConsentSheet.tsx defaultChoices marketing/whatsapp/sms = true and app/complete-profile.tsx pre-ticked opt-in: the consent row is still an audit/outbox record mirrored to the server (queueConsentMirror), so structurally compliant; the issue is legal (pre-ticked promotional consent), not persistence.

lib/appReview.ts markAsked/markRatingSettled AsyncStorage flags (existing keys, now also set by requestNativeReview): UI preference, allowed; but 5f92d2e keeps the device-global keys that phase2 scoped per uid (k(base)), so a merge must keep the scoped form.
lib/taglines.ts / lib/cartReminder.ts: OS-scheduled local notifications (scheduleNotificationAsync), cancelled on sign-out via lib/auth.tsx:93-94. Not domain data; no table or key written.

lib/foundingFamily.ts, components/FoundingCard.tsx, app/(tabs)/vip.tsx, app/founding-family/*: no local write at all; membership, farms, price and line number are read from the server on every focus. Compliant.

constants/legal.ts (generated) and constants/societies.ts (Celebrity Gardens): static content baked into the bundle, not member state. Allowed; note the legal text is now a build-time snapshot, so the app and website drift again until the script is re-run.
lib/leads.ts (unchanged call path) insertRow('leads') only when no backend is configured; in backend mode the lead goes to POST /partner-leads and nothing is stored locally. Allowed.
overlap_with_phase2: lib/subscriptions.ts: ours rewrote it (+329/-185: server session cache keyed by uid, listSubscriptions({refresh}), local table = outbox only in backend mode, subscriptionWire, vacationsFromServer, syncServerSubscriptions DELETED); 5f92d2e adds a 10-line duplicate guard reading getRows('subscriptions'). Semantic conflict: his guard is a no-op against our outbox-only table, and his app/(tabs)/index.tsx:35,200 and components/SubscriptionStatusCard.tsx:9,42 still import/call syncServerSubscriptions, so a merge that takes his side of those files does not compile. Resolution: keep ours; re-implement the guard as (await listSubscriptions()).some(active|paused && product_id) and require the backend DUPLICATE_SUBSCRIPTION anyway.

lib/notifications.ts: three-way. Ours added installTapHandler (latched), hrefFromResponse, unregisterPush (C2 DELETE /push/register), registerForPush singleflight with EAS projectId; 81a33ec (under his commit) replaced the 'registered' flag with per-uid registeredFor + announcePushForCurrentSession; 5f92d2e adds scheduleAt, cancelScheduledWhere, ensureCategories, onNotificationTap (cold-start + 'view-cart' action), identifier/category on LocalNotice and a tagline-muting foreground handler. Conflict: two tap routers would both be installed in app/_layout.tsx and route every tap twice; two push-registration models. Resolution: keep ours' installTapHandler and extend it with his actionIdentifier==='view-cart' and getLastNotificationResponseAsync handling; keep ours' registerForPush/unregisterPush and fold 81a33ec's per-uid registeredFor semantics into it; take his scheduleAt/cancelScheduledWhere/ensureCategories/identifier verbatim.

app/_layout.tsx: ours installs installTapHandler, hydrateAddressCache and registerForPush after session; his installs onNotificationTap, ensureCategories, rescheduleTaglines on session and on background, scheduleCartReminder/cancelCartReminder on app-state change. Resolution: merge both hook bodies, single tap handler (ours), keep his background scheduling.

components/RateAppSheet.tsx: 5f92d2e DELETED it (native expo-store-review prompt, Apple 5.6.1) while ours MODIFIED it (store offered to every rating, error surface, markRatingSettled on register rejection). Resolution: accept the deletion and requestNativeReview/openStoreReview (the compliant path), but keep ours' scoped-key appReview.ts and re-home the 'tell us what went wrong' path on the complaints screen; app/(tabs)/index.tsx and profile.tsx take his side for the sheet removal.

lib/appReview.ts: ours scoped KEY_DONE/KEY_LAST_ASKED/KEY_DELIVERED per uid via k(base); his adds requestNativeReview/openStoreReview and rewrites the header comment on the un-scoped keys. Resolution: his additions on top of ours' scoped keys (markAsked must stay scoped).

lib/orderTracking.ts: ours switched the poll to fetchOrders (no settle sweep), keyed SEEN_KEY per uid, added isStaleOnFirstSight and announce(uid, o); his added deliveryDayOf, isActive(o, today), Swiggy-style arrivalTitle/noticeFor, identifier 'order:<id>' and arrivalLine. Textual conflict in announce() and useLiveOrders(); no semantic clash. Resolution: ours' fetch/uid/stale logic + his date filter, copy, identifier and arrivalLine.

lib/referrals.ts: ours makes getReferredBy return null and setReferredBy return false without writing in backend mode (no server attribution exists); his makes them server-first with a local write regardless of the POST result and a codeFromUid fallback. Opposite policies. Resolution: take his server-first reads (GET /referrals/code, GET /referrals) once the endpoints exist, but keep ours' rule that nothing is stored as a promise until POST /referrals/apply succeeds (or queue it in the mirror outbox), and no on-device code derivation in backend mode; his complete-profile.tsx call ignores the return value so both signatures work.

lib/notificationCenter.ts: ours added dropNoticesTheServerSent (local vs CRM inbox dedupe) and unread-only markCrmRead; his changed fromCrm.href to crmCtaRoute(m.cta) and passes identifier through notify(). Different hunks, no semantic clash; merge both.

app/(tabs)/index.tsx: ours' 3-line change (listSubscriptions({refresh:true}) replacing syncServerSubscriptions) vs his removal of LiveOrderCard/WelcomeProgressCard/RateAppSheet, new ActiveOrdersCard, requestNativeReview and tab styling. Mergeable only if ours' subscription lines win (his still calls the deleted function).

components/ConsentSheet.tsx: ours reads 'latest' from GET /users/me/consents with an error state and flushConsentMirror; his flips defaultChoices marketing/whatsapp/sms to true and drops the email row. Mergeable; note his defaultChoices() is what taglines.offersOn falls back to, and ours' server-latest should be what it reads.

lib/vip.ts: ours drops the local 'vip' table in backend mode inside getVip; his makes memberLinePrice return the regular price. Different functions, merge both (his PromoGate still imports getVip and friends, which still exist).
lib/support.ts: ours files support-chat tickets on the complaints register in backend mode; his changes GRIEVANCE_OFFICER/GRIEVANCE_EMAIL. Different hunks, merge both.
lib/autoTopup.ts: ours per-uid scoped keys + clearAutoTopup; his one-line DEFAULTS.on = true. Merge both; decide whether on-by-default should survive clearAutoTopup for the next account.

app/message-preferences.tsx (ours: error state/disable; his: rescheduleTaglines on marketing toggle), app/(tabs)/profile.tsx (ours: one error-message line; his: Founding Family card, Messages/Chat/Care/FAQ rows removed, openStoreReview), app/(tabs)/wallet.tsx (ours: getAutopay catch; his: BackButton), app/subscriptions.tsx (ours: SERVER_FREQS gating and low-balance copy; his: noon copy), app/complaints.tsx (ours: registerError; his: grievance wording): all small, non-clashing hunks, straightforward merges.

Files only he changed that touch code ours depends on: components/LiveOrderCard.tsx deleted (ours' index.tsx still renders it until his index.tsx wins), app/inbox.tsx turned into a Redirect (ours' profile.tsx still links Messages to /inbox, harmless), components/SubscriptionStatusCard.tsx untouched by him but calls the syncServerSubscriptions ours deleted (already fixed on ours). Branch note: 5f92d2e's parent 81a33ec is origin/feature/consumer-revamp-phase2, so his 'fast-forward of phase2' claim is true for the pushed tip but not for our local phase2 (44 unpushed commits since 5730291).
results.recommendation: Do not merge 5f92d2e into feature/consumer-revamp-phase2 now. Have Kushagra merge (or rebase onto) our phase2 into his branch first, resolving the four hard-conflict files on our semantics: lib/subscriptions.ts (his index.tsx and SubscriptionStatusCard.tsx still call syncServerSubscriptions, which we deleted, so the naive merge does not compile; his duplicate guard reads a table that is outbox-only for us), lib/notifications.ts and app/_layout.tsx (two tap routers and two push-registration models; keep installTapHandler/unregisterPush and add his scheduleAt/cancelScheduledWhere/ensureCategories/view-cart action), lib/referrals.ts (his local referred_by write before server acceptance reverses our backend-as-truth rule) and components/RateAppSheet.tsx (accept his deletion and the native prompt, keep our per-uid appReview keys). Reasons: (1) his commit is one 55-file squash on top of origin's phase2 tip (81a33ec) while our local phase2 carries 44 further commits from the same base, so he holds the smaller diff and the merge is cheaper on his side; (2) 18 files overlap and the big ones are ours' architectural rewrites, so ours must be the base; (3) six of his new endpoints (founding-family x3, referrals x3) do not exist in module.go and the backend also lacks the DUPLICATE_SUBSCRIPTION guard and past-day order closure, so the Founding Family tab, profile card, PromoGate and referral flows are inert until the backend ships them, which removes any urgency to land them now. Meanwhile cherry-pick into phase2 the backend-independent, non-overlapping pieces: constants/legal.ts + scripts/sync-legal.py + app/terms.tsx + app/privacy-policy.tsx, constants/societies.ts (Celebrity Gardens), the lib/support.ts grievance hunk and app/complaints.tsx copy, app/support.tsx FAQ row, app/inbox.tsx redirect plus the notificationCenter crmCtaRoute hunk, app/bulk-order.tsx + app/business.tsx (P-DAN; backend already accepts kind 'agent'), the orderTracking deliveryDayOf/isActive/arrivalLine hunks with app/(tabs)/orders.tsx and components/ActiveOrdersCard.tsx (re-applied over our fetchOrders/uid version), the wallet BackButton and the PyaasTabBar label. Hold for decisions or backend: Founding Family screens and lib/foundingFamily.ts (safe to land only behind the null-gate once the endpoints are agreed, and drop the client PLUS_PRICE_MONTH in PromoGate), referrals (endpoints plus the Rs100-vs-line-move policy), consent defaults on and auto top-up on (legal exposure the handoff itself flags), 2-hourly taglines (should gate on the server's consent state, and the volume needs a founder sign-off), and the duplicate-subscription guard (rewrite against listSubscriptions and rely on the server). Backend side, the concrete to-do list is the six routes, DUPLICATE_SUBSCRIPTION in createSubscription, closure of past-day locked orders, member-level pricing in catalog_price.go, the noon lock in the subscription worker, and the em-dash strings in consumer/service.go and identity/service.go.

results.summary: Read-only analysis of 5f92d2e (Kushagra, 22 Sep, 55 files) plus its parent 81a33ec (push fix, also on ui-revamp) against feature/consumer-revamp-phase2 HEAD f7e19be (44 commits since the common base 5730291; the handoff's claim that ui-revamp is a fast-forward of phase2 is true only as of 5730291). A `git merge-tree --write-tree HEAD 5f92d2e` dry run (object DB only, tree f72a9a8, no worktree/index touched) shows exactly 5 textual conflicts: app/_layout.tsx, components/RateAppSheet.tsx (modify/delete), lib/notifications.ts, lib/referrals.ts, lib/subscriptions.ts; the other 13 overlapping files auto-merge and I checked each merged blob for semantic breakage. PERSISTENCE: the commit is mostly compliant (Founding Family is server-only with no local row, cart reminder/taglines are OS-scheduled notifications derived from the cart) but it re-introduces three things phase2 removed: a local mirror of the server's referral code (lib/referrals.ts:68), a fire-and-forget local `referral_meta` attribution written before/regardless of POST /referrals/apply (lib/referrals.ts:126, reverting phase2 1310a9a), and a taglines Offers gate that reads the LOCAL consents table with a default of true instead of the server's consent state (lib/taglines.ts:82-83) — which, combined with phase2's sign-out purge of parag:consents:<uid>, makes marketing taglines fire for a member who opted out on the server. Two money/traffic hazards ride along: lib/taglines.ts:116 calls listOrders(), which on phase2 runs the settleDeliveredOrders wallet sweep on every backgrounding and session start (phase2 e705ad0 moved polling to fetchOrders for this reason), and the merged tree installs two notification tap handlers so every tap navigates twice. The DUPLICATE_SUBSCRIPTION guard reads the local subscriptions table, which in phase2 backend mode is only the offline outbox, so it never sees server plans (dead in exactly the mode where the founder's duplicate happened). BACKEND: none of the six new endpoints (founding-family x3, referrals x3) exist in module.go; partner-leads already accepts kind 'agent' (free string); createSubscription has no duplicate check; the worker still locks at midnight while the app copy now says 12 noon; closed-app order pushes come from CRM templates with data {href,trigger_id,category}, not the Swiggy shape with identifier order:<id>. Recommendation: merge 5f92d2e (with 81a33ec) into phase2 now, resolved by us with the six named fixes, then Kushagra fast-forwards ui-revamp; do not cherry-pick and do not have him merge phase2 into his branch.

results.recommendation: Merge 5f92d2e into feature/consumer-revamp-phase2 now, resolved by us, then have Kushagra fast-forward feature/ui-revamp to phase2. Reasons: (1) the dry run proves the conflict set is small and known (5 files, tree f72a9a8 already in the object DB), but every conflict sits in a file whose design phase2 owns (notifications registration/unbind, referrals no-local rule, subscriptions outbox model, _layout boot order), so the resolver must know phase2's persistence rules; that is us, not him. (2) His branch forked at 5730291 and is 44 commits behind; asking him to merge phase2 into ui-revamp gives him the same five conflicts plus 13 auto-merges to re-verify, with the rule context in our heads. (3) Cherry-picking parts does not work: taglines and cartReminder depend on the notifications additions, Founding Family replaces PYAAS Plus across six screens and PromoGate, the RateAppSheet deletion is tied to index/profile rewrites, and the legal sync spans terms/privacy/support. Resolve with these six fixes in the merge commit: one tap handler (theirs plus our href guard), uid push latch plus our DELETE on sign-out (drop his sign-out re-announce), referrals with no local write in backend mode and a memory-cached code, DUPLICATE_SUBSCRIPTION via listSubscriptions(), taglines gated on the server's consent state and reading fetchOrders() not listOrders(), and cancelTaglines/cancelCartReminder moved into session.signOut. Exclude the .specstory and .vscode files. Then, before any founder demo, the backend adds founding-family (GET, join, stop), referrals (code, list, apply), the DUPLICATE_SUBSCRIPTION 409, and moves the worker lock to 12 noon or the copy reverts; until then the app degrades as Kushagra designed it (Founding Family 'opens soon', referrals fall back).
